_meta.status: post-hoc re-analysis with normalized FORMAT scoring
_meta.rule: Normalized FORMAT: whitespace around the response is ignored. If the response is exactly one code fence, opened by ``` or ```json (any letter case; optional spaces or tabs and an optional line break after the opening) and closed by ``` at the very end, with no further ``` inside, the strict FORMAT check is applied to the content of the fence. Otherwise the strict FORMAT check is applied to the response itself. Strict FORMAT: the text parses as JSON without duplicate keys into an object whose keys are exactly answer and evidence. Nothing is repaired.
